name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 10 visits over 80 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2026-06-29, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
